rules.rule: No starburst, no price slash and no hot saturated sale colour on any type, panel, rule, button or icon.
No colour outside the 5 palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons; the supplied roundel artwork keeps its own colours.
Showroom White is the ground behind all type; Meridian Navy is the only other ground, for a band, panel or seal carrying reversed type.
Prices, mileage and listing detail always sit on Showroom White, never on a Meridian Navy band.
Meridian Navy never sits behind a vehicle.
On Showroom White, prices are Meridian Navy.
On Showroom White, mileage and listing detail are Graphite.
On Showroom White, headings, labels and the dealership name are Meridian Navy.
On Meridian Navy, type is Showroom White, except small seal lettering, which may be Steel Grey.
Fine print is Graphite or, as the one small muted line, Steel Grey.
Compass Teal is for the price rule, other hairline rules and seal compass needles only; never a ground or a type colour.
Steel Grey is for keylines, box rules, the photo-well border, one small muted line and small seal lettering only; never a ground.
Compass Teal and Steel Grey together are no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.

Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. The three bays' casts (warm apron, yellow-orange wash bay, dim cool-green back row) are corrected to one even, neutral showroom white, but each car keeps its true paint: the Ardmoor Ridge stays deep red and does not swing orange, the black Brookmere Sable keeps its shadow-side detail, and the pale rooflines of the white Norsted Alta and the silver Calder Kestrel are not clipped into the background.

Use only meridian_roundel_transparent.svg, meridian_roundel_reversed.svg, meridian_roundel_transparent.png or meridian_roundel_reversed.png, placed unchanged; meridian_roundel.png is not the production file.
The roundel is placed with its knock-outs open: no white square, the ground shows through its rings, rose and lettering.

rules.rule: The roundel's hairline inner ring and MERIDIAN MOTORS lettering stay open and legible.
Display / H1: the price in Source Serif 4 Bold, the ceiling of the scale.
Subheading / H2: year, make and model in Source Serif 4 Bold.
Body: mileage and listing detail in Source Sans 3 Regular, max 65 characters a line.
Fine print: disclosure in Source Sans 3 Regular, smaller than body.
Signature move: the dollar sign at sixty percent of numeral height, raised to the figure tops.
A 1 pt Compass Teal rule sits below the price across the full vehicle-card width, or across that vehicle's panel in the campaign.
The price keeps tabular lining figures.
A separately typeset Meridian Motors label beside the supplied roundel uses Source Serif 4 Bold.
Only the two supplied families (Source Serif 4, Source Sans 3) are used for new type.
Body: plain information, stated once.
